公(metric) + 里(a half-kilometer) → the metric version of the 里: 公里(kilometer).
a 口(mouth) shouts a question at a 馬(horse) → 嗎(question particle).
Workers pile 土(earth) into a wall to 成(complete) a fort → 城(city; town).
Repeating 大(big) twice for emphasis: 大大 means greatly.
弟(younger brother), said twice: 弟弟(younger brother).
